latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Instagram Photo Video Maker.

- Instantly turn JPG, PNG, HEIC, or WebP photo collections into 1080p Instagram reels or stories.
- Cloud-based: No local installs required, fast GPU-accelerated renders (typically 30-60s per video).
- Automatic setup with free credits; just upload images and describe the video you want.
- Supports text overlays, audio tracks, and custom instructions through simple chat prompts.
- Provides real-time feedback, timeline summaries, and easy download of exported MP4 videos.
